title: Finite regular coefficient comparisons and prescribed pullback compositor
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and $A_m=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^{m+1}$ for $m\in\mathbf N$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For a scheme $Y$ with its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], define the regular coefficient complex $B_{Y,m}[0]$ to be the degree-zero complex of the regular module over the constant ring sheaf $B_{Y,m}=(A_m)_Y$. For an isomorphism $g:X\to Y$, let $c_m:g^{-1}B_{Y,m}[0]\xrightarrow{\sim}B_{X,m}[0]$ be the constant-section coefficient comparison of [def-weil-constant-weil-structure], with the transported module action. Let $\kappa_m:g^{-1}B_{Y,m}[0]\to g_m^*B_{Y,m}[0]$ be the termwise map $z\mapsto z\otimes1$ of [def-weil-inverse-image-pullback-comparison](a), and let $\lambda_m$ be its inverse, the multiplication $z\otimes b\mapsto c_m^{-1}(b)z$. These are the existing coefficient constructions, with no new choice. For arbitrary scheme maps $f:X\to Y$ and $g:Y\to Z$, define the compositor for the intrinsic finite derived pullbacks of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] to be the canonical ringed-site compositor of [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition] specialized to the constant rings $B_{Z,m},B_{Y,m},B_{X,m}$, transported to intrinsic coordinates by the unique comparison of the tensor pullback with the intrinsic exact module inverse image that preserves their adjunction units on every section. This transport is applied termwise and descended to the derived category; its direction is $L(f\mathbin{\gg}g)^*\cong Lg^*\mathbin{\gg}Lf^*$.
